_comment: Registration for the lanes check in `flow-plan-record.py approve` (issue #1731).
WHY IT NEEDS COMMITTED CASES (ADR 0008): approval lets a plan THROUGH, and
nothing downstream re-derives whether the plan answered the project's lanes.
Before this check, three plans in one afternoon were approved without the
table and one merged that way.
Each case is one run section and, where the project lists lanes, one lane
file. run-case.py builds a throwaway repository, appends the section to a new
run's plan record and asks the gate to approve it.
FOUR BAD CASES, because the check has four ways to be owed: no table at
all, a listed lane with no row, a row whose answer is not one of the four,
and a lane file that exists but lists nothing (which must not read as a
detect_signal: ^FLOW_PLAN_RECORD: error - (the plan record has no lanes table|the lanes table leaves these listed lanes unanswered|unknown: )
limits: Covers the APPROVAL refusal for a readable lane file and for one that lists nothing. It does not cover the one-line waiver (`Lanes: none - <reason>`), a missing sibling lane-file.py, the other unusable-file states, the stability digest's treatment of the `Lanes demonstrated` block, or the close-time stderr report - those are pinned by tests/test_flow_plan_record_lanes.py. It says nothing about whether an answer is TRUE: a plan can answer every lane `will test` and test none of them.

cases.name: bad-no-table
cases.why: A project with three listed lanes and a plan with no lanes table: the #1731 case, the state of three approved plans on 2026-11-11. If it scores GOOD the check cannot see a missing table.

cases.name: bad-one-lane-missing
cases.why: The table answers two of three listed lanes. If it scores GOOD the check reads 'a table is present' as 'every lane is answered'.

cases.name: bad-answer-is-not-one-of-the-four
cases.why: Every lane has a row, and one answer is `tbd`. If it scores GOOD a row counts as an answer whatever it says.

cases.name: bad-lane-file-lists-nothing
cases.why: The lane file exists and its table is gone. If it scores GOOD an unusable list is being read as a project with no lanes.

cases.name: good-every-lane-answered
cases.why: Every listed lane answered, one with a split answer. Separates a working check from one wedged at refuse.

cases.name: good-no-lane-file
cases.why: A project that has not adopted lanes, and a plan with no table. It must be approved exactly as before: this is every repository but one today.

anchors.why: HISTORICAL: the helper as merged before #1731. Its approve never opens the lane file, so it stamps all four bad cases.
